name: Python 3.11 Research Environment
updateContentCommand: [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y && sudo xargs apt install -y <packages.txt; [ -f requirements.txt ] && pip3 install --user -r requirements.txt; [ -f docs/requirements.txt ] && pip3 install --user -r docs/requirements.txt; echo 'Packages installed and requirements met'
